meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把 Discord 机器人接入 NanoClaw 系统，自动复制适配器、注册通道、安装依赖并验证，最后配置机器人凭证并重启服务，使机器人可以接收和发送 Discord 消息。
howto.when: 当你需要让 NanoClaw 通过 Discord 机器人与你聊天时触发，通常在系统初始化或添加新通道时使用。

say.text: 帮我添加 Discord 机器人通道。
say.note: 开始执行整个添加流程。

say.text: 复制 Discord 适配器并注册。
say.note: 只执行复制和注册步骤。

say.text: 配置 Discord 机器人令牌。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you integrate a Discord bot into NanoClaw by copying the adapter, registering the channel, installing dependencies, validating the build, configuring credentials, and restarting the service so the bot can send and receive messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw, typically during initial setup or when adding a new communication channel.

say_en.text: Copy and register the Discord adapter.
say_en.note: Only performs copy and registration steps.
Prompts you to paste the Bot Token.
